# design-os-svg-animation

> Deterministic vector animation and 1080p 60fps motion video pipeline for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity). Motion IR compiler, virtual clock quantizing, proactive pre-flight guard, and 6 anti-flop verification gates.

A motion engineering pipeline that compiles Motion IR storyboards to CSS and GSAP, renders broadcast MP4s with headless Chromium virtual clocks, and audits output against proactive pre-flight quality guards and 6 anti-flop gates.

## Documentation

- [Overview & Dual Carousel Showcase](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/): Interactive landing page with live animations and dual video showcase (Claude Design 82s & OpenAI Codex App 38s).
- [Reference Recreation Contract](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/motion-video-recreation-pipeline.html): Source evidence, HyperFrames staging, transition review, encoded-output checks, acceptance states, and session handoff.
- [Recreation Lessons and Review Guide](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/motion-video-recreation-workflow-guide.html): Astra case failures and evidence-based review method.
- [Motion IR Specification](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/motion-ir.html): Full specification for the intermediate representation.
- [Architecture Overview](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/architecture-overview.html): Multi-stage video rendering pipeline and virtual clock mechanism.
- [Quality & Safety Gates](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/quality-and-safety-gates.html): The 6 deterministic anti-flop validation criteria and pre-flight guard.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-svg-animation): Source code, CLI commands, and test suites.

## Core Features & Workflow

- **Motion IR**: JSON intermediate representation capturing keyframes, easings, spatial trajectories, and timeline markers.
- **Virtual Clock Engine**: Drives headless Chromium via explicit timestamp increments (1/60s), eliminating dropped frames.
- **Pre-Flight Guard & 6 Anti-Flop Gates**: Boundary clipping prevention, SVG glyph fill audits, camera decoupling, frame drift, color gamut, font loading, and timeline integrity audits.
